plan.notes: Official 2026-2027 Major Map (recommended sequence) for the Bachelor of Arts in Journalism & Mass Communications (B.A.J.M.C.), College of Information and Communications, School of Journalism and Mass Communications, from the USC Major Map Repository (2026_jour_map.pdf). All 8 semesters transcribed; semester sums verified against printed totals (15/15/15/15/15/15/15/14 at slot minimums = 119 total; official degree minimum 120 per Graduation Requirements Summary: 120 total, 48 major, 29-41 college/program, 31-43 Carolina Core — range slots/electives fill to 120+). Ranged slots transcribed at minimums with notes: Foreign language/other CC (3-4) at 3; Carolina Core Req (3-4) at 3. NOTE: minimum institutional GPA 2.5. Foreign language proficiency equivalent to the 122 course required. Journalism Major Electives (18 hrs): 1 professional-practice directed elective + 2 conceptual directed electives + 3 additional JOUR electives; Sports Media Concentration (12 hrs) option documented. Retrieved 2026-10-09.
